records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in revenue was driven by increased activity in our OFSE and IET segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2023, our OFSE segment recognized orders of $4.1 billion, an increase of $0.8 billion, or 25% and our IET segment recognized orders of $3.5 billion, a decrease of $35 million, or 1% compared to the three months ended March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the first quarter of 2023, we generated revenue of $5,716 million compared to $4,835 million in the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Outside North America, customer spending is most heavily influenced by Brent oil prices, which decreased from the same quarter last year, ranging from a high of $87.54/Bbl in January 2023 to a low of $71.03/Bbl in March 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income in the first quarter of 2023 was $438 million compared to $279 million in the first quarter of 2022.
